causal_trace.summary: An HTTP requester controls CGI filename/path content, including a quotation mark followed by a space, supplied to the CGI servlet.

When an executable command string contains spaces and does not begin with a quotation mark, CGI.java wraps the whole attacker-influenced string in quotation marks. An embedded quotation mark followed by a space then produces multiple command-line tokens rather than one requested executable token.

The constructed command-line string is passed to Runtime.exec. In the report's example, the checked path exec" commands/bin1 becomes a command that runs exec with commands/bin1 as an argument instead of running bin1.

The report states that the EE9/EE10 CGI quotation-escaping error enables arbitrary command execution; it also identifies alias-check bypass and unintended behavior when a command prefix is configured.

failure.operation: Passing a malformed, quote-wrapped command-line string to Runtime.exec

primary_invariant.statement: A CGI request's intended executable path must remain one executable token when passed for process execution and must not be reinterpreted as a different executable plus attacker-influenced arguments.
primary_invariant.violated_because: Whole-string quotation wrapping does not safely preserve tokenization when attacker-controlled path content includes a quotation mark followed by a space.

quality.review_notes: The primary audit report gives a concrete request-to-Runtime.exec scenario and states arbitrary command execution. However, the bundle contains no immutable upstream patch, exact affected release/commit, regression test, or captured independent execution result. The report describes a fix-review delivery but the inspected evidence does not establish a TOB-JETTY-3-specific remediation outcome.

remediation.invariant_restored: Process invocation must preserve the requested executable path as one executable argument and prevent quotation characters in requester-controlled path content from changing executable or argument boundaries.
mitigation_classes: preserve executable and argument token boundaries during CGI process invocation
